team_prior_method.offense: team points-for mean shrunk toward league team-points mean
team_prior_method.defense: team points-allowed mean shrunk toward league team-points mean
team_prior_method.home_field: empirical mean home-minus-away score over the locked history window
team_prior_method.score_sd: empirical standard deviation of team scores over the locked history window
team_prior_method.home_away_score_correlation: empirical Pearson correlation of paired home and away final scores

pregame_mean_method.home_points: average(home shrunk offense, away shrunk defense) + home_field_advantage/2
pregame_mean_method.away_points: average(away shrunk offense, home shrunk defense) - home_field_advantage/2

distribution_method.family: correlated Gaussian score simulation with nonnegative integer score realization

locked_rules: Sportsbook lines, odds, implied probabilities, consensus prices and vig are prohibited from game forecast generation.
Only final historical games may enter team scoring priors.
The 2026 game schedule must come from the verified football schedule ledger.
Game forecasts are generated before any market comparison.
Player projections may not be translated into team points with arbitrary weights; a future calibrated bridge is required before they can alter game-score means.
Missing team priors block that game instead of silently substituting a market line.
All outputs remain SHADOW_ONLY and non-actionable until prospective calibration governance promotes them.
